summary.description: One or two sentences for the PR reviewer on what the new tests cover; shown at the top of the PR comment.

decisions.description: One decision per source file in the task.

path.description: Source file the decision is about, relative to the repo root.

attention.description: What the PR reviewer must act on, one short sentence each: production bugs the tests exposed, behavior in scope left untested and why. Empty when the tests cover the change. Shown on the PR.

skills_used.description: Names of the skills you loaded.
